transient: a read of the issue file the file system or database refuses for a moment (retried by the registry, up to 3 tries)
permanent: an issue number the tracker does not hold
a number below 1
an argument of the wrong type, missing or unknown (refused at the boundary)

transient: a read of the prebuilt index the file system refuses for a moment (retried by the registry, up to 3 tries)
permanent: an empty or whitespace-only query
a query longer than 200 characters
a path_glob that is not a valid glob
max_results outside 1 to 20
a response_format or source outside its enum

transient: a read the file system refuses for a moment (retried by the registry, up to 3 tries)
permanent: a path that is not in the repository's file list, case included (a near miss)
a path under config/
a path that leaves the repository (leading / or ..)
a start_line past the end of the file
a file that is not text

transient: a write refused before it was sent (the mock tracker has none: every timeout it raises may have committed)
permanent: an issue number the tracker does not hold
an empty body
a body over 4,000 characters
a body whose first two lines are not label and file
a body that a pre-call hook denies (a credential assignment)
ambiguous: a write that timed out after dispatch (TrackerTimeout): the comment may have committed; read back by key, retried with the same key, or escalated when it cannot be read back

transient: a write refused before it was sent (the mock tracker has none)
permanent: an issue number the tracker does not hold
a branch other than repomind/issue-<n>
an empty or overlong title, or a title with line breaks
an empty or overlong body
ambiguous: a write that timed out after dispatch (TrackerTimeout): the PR may have opened; read back by key and branch, retried with the same key, or escalated when it cannot be read back
